### Added
- **The data plane traces a share of the requests that arrive with no trace context: `gateway.tracing.randomSampling`, 0.1, on the `<release>-tracing` AgentgatewayPolicy (`frontend.tracing.randomSampling`)** (giantswarm/giantswarm#36711). Before, the data plane traced only requests with a sampled `traceparent`, so an MCP client such as Claude Code through muster got no data-plane span. The value is a number between 0 and 1 or a boolean; empty or 0 turns random sampling off and keeps the export of traced requests. A request with an unsampled `traceparent` stays untraced. The span metrics of `service="agentgateway"` now mix all traced requests with this share of the others; `agentgateway_requests_total` stays the source for rates. `make verify-dataplane-tracing` asserts the value, the overrides, the schema and the meta chart's forwarding. Both charts carry the default. README "The data plane's traces".
